answer: Each bonded identity escrows collateral, but correlated equivocation links the keys: evidence across k identities produces penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, or O(k²), not merely a per-key fee. Detection then applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation reduces the value of what remains. Splitting stake across a sybil swarm therefore amplifies risk; a pulse of honest activity cannot let attackers wander beyond the audit horizon.
